proposal.expected_benefit: This strategy will reduce the likelihood of consensus divergence by addressing potential issues before they escalate, thereby improving the overall safety and reliability of the PBFT protocol.
proposal.problem: The mitigation strategy lacks proactive measures to prevent consensus divergence before it occurs.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement proactive PBFT safety mechanisms that continuously monitor network health and detect early signs of consensus divergence. These mechanisms should include predictive analytics and real-time anomaly detection to trigger preventive actions before consensus divergence becomes critical.
proposal.title: Proactive PBFT Safety Enhancement
verification_tests: Simulate early-stage consensus divergence scenarios to validate the effectiveness of proactive detection mechanisms.
Evaluate the system's response time and accuracy in identifying and mitigating potential consensus divergence triggers.
